summary: Verified all 4 fixes for iteration 56: (1) VAD silence_filter -40dB threshold confirmed in ai.py, (2) transcript cap at 80,000 chars with truncation note confirmed in analyze_meeting, (3) POST /api/processing/{meeting_id}/retry endpoint works correctly (404/400/401 edge cases all pass), (4) Backend syntax fully valid — all imports clean. 12/12 tests passed. Note: public URL was returning 502 (Cloudflare Bad Gateway) at test time — tests fell back to localhost:8001.

minor.issue: Public URL returned 502 Bad Gateway from Cloudflare at test time (2026-08-08 20:02 UTC). Backend was healthy on localhost:8001. Likely a transient routing/deployment issue.

action_items: Note: review_request described retry as 'GET /api/processing/{meeting_id}/retry' but the actual implementation (and correct implementation) is POST. The test confirms GET returns 405. No code change needed — POST is the right method.

Note: happy-path retry test (processing_failed + audio_file present → 200) was not exercised because creating such a DB state requires audio upload. The negative cases (404, 400, 401) all pass, and the code path is straightforward.
critical_code_review_comments: ai.py line 82-85: silence_filter correctly uses -40dB for both silenceremove steps — confirmed
ai.py line 1194: transcript_text[:80000] with conditional truncation note '[TRANSCRIPT TRUNCATED — analyse the above portion only]' — confirmed
processing.py line 385: retry endpoint is POST (not GET as stated in review_request). This is the correct HTTP method for a state-changing operation.

processing.py line 397: retry is allowed for statuses: processing_failed, processing, in_review, reviewed — not just processing_failed. The error message says 'Only processing_failed meetings can be retried' which is slightly misleading.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ meetings created and deleted during test (test_retry_wrong_status and test_retry_no_audio_file fixtures)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 preventive fixes confirmed: (1) VAD threshold = -40dB in ai.py _compress_to_mp3 silence_filter (lines 81-85), (2) transcript cap at 80000 chars with '[TRANSCRIPT TRUNCATED]' note in analyze_meeting (line 1194), (3) POST /api/processing/{id}/retry endpoint functional (returns 404/400/401 for invalid inputs). Backend syntax valid. Public URL had transient 502 — test file uses localhost fallback. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_vad_threshold_and_retry.py (12 tests).
rca_of_issue: The production 'Processing Failed' was caused by: (1) Primary cause: edited_summary column missing in analyses table (fixed in iteration 55 via ALTER TABLE IF NOT EXISTS). (2) Secondary preventive fix: VAD silence_filter threshold raised from -50dB to -40dB to trim near-silence/background noise more aggressively before sending to AssemblyAI. (3) Tertiary preventive fix: transcript capped at 80,000 chars to prevent context overflow if AssemblyAI hallucinates during silence. All 3 fixes confirmed in codebase.
